title: Vallejo Police Officers Shoot Suspect Who Pointed BB Gun at Them
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Vallejo, California — On August 29, 2025, at approximately 6:01 p.m., officers from the Vallejo Police Department responded to a report of possible vandalism to a vehicle in the 2000 block of Ascot Parkway. They were informed that the subject involved was wanted on several outstanding felony and misdemeanor warrants. Upon arrival, the officers located the subject, identified as 24-year-old Alexander Schumann, who immediately walked towards them and pointed what appeared to be a handgun at them, resulting in an officer-involved shooting. Officers immediately rendered medical aid, and Schumann was transported to an area hospital via helicopter, where he remains in stable condition. The weapon located at the scene was later determined to be a pellet/BB gun.
